shell.description: Texpio is your local-first text expander. Your library and the native expansion engine are being built here.
shell.probeStatus: The Windows probe starts stopped. Open Developer to inspect the current experiment.
probe.ui.experimental-feasibility-contro: Experimental feasibility controls. Use disposable test documents; the engine starts stopped on every app launch.
probe.ui.only-the-selected-reference-con: Only the selected reference control can expand. Other applications and password fields are refused.
probe.ui.submitted-requests-are-counted-: Submitted requests are counted separately from observed output. The tray can pause or stop the probe while this window is hidden.
probe.ui.type-a-shortcut-followed-by-spa: Type a shortcut followed by Space. One trailing space remains. Start at the beginning of the field or after whitespace.
developer.ui.application-information-fro: Application information from the native desktop shell.

developer.ui.closing-this-window-keeps-t: Closing this window keeps Texpio running. To exit, choose Quit from the tray menu.

library.title: Snippet library
library.description: Your snippets stay on this computer. Save changes explicitly.
library.support: Windows Notepad only · US or English (India) keyboard · Type a trigger followed by Space. The engine starts stopped; saves and imports stop it.
library.probeActive: A Developer probe session is active. Stop it before starting the library.
library.saved: Saved. Start expansion again to use your changes.
library.emptyDescription: Try another search or create a snippet.
library.field.title: Title
library.triggerHelp: Use ; followed by 1–31 lowercase ASCII letters, for example ;hello. Finish with Space.
library.bodyHelp: Literal plain text, up to 16,384 Unicode characters. Tabs and line breaks are supported; template tokens are not evaluated.
library.chooseDescription: Select a saved snippet or create a new one to start writing.
library.discardDescription: Your draft has not been saved. Continue editing or discard it to proceed.
library.folderHelp: Removing a folder moves its snippets to Unfiled. Snippets are kept.
library.importHelp: Import adds records. Conflicting identities or active triggers are refused without changing the library.
library.pickerHelp: Choose Copy or press Enter for the first result, then paste where you need it. Escape closes the picker.
library.validation.title: Enter a name of 1–120 characters.
library.validation.trigger: Use ; followed by 1–31 lowercase ASCII letters.
library.validation.body: Enter 1–16,384 Unicode characters. Only Tab and line breaks are allowed as control characters.
library.validation.duplicateTrigger: This trigger is already used by an enabled snippet.
library.error.invalidData: The library contains invalid data. Nothing was saved.
library.error.conflict: The library changed in another window. Your draft is kept. Reload before saving again.
library.error.storage: The library could not be saved. Your draft is kept. Check disk access and try again.
library.error.tooLarge: This file exceeds the 8 MiB import limit.
library.error.unsupportedVersion: This library format is not supported.
library.error.unavailable: Open the Texpio desktop app to use the native library. If it is already open, retry the operation.
library.error.importConflict: The file conflicts with existing IDs or active triggers, or the library changed. No records were imported. Review the file or reload.
